notes.title: Below Sunshade: Dreams of Fate
notes.content:
Hey folks!

Today we've released the final update for Below Sunshade! Dreams of Fate. 
We want to thank everyone who supported us along the way and we hope you enjoy the new Update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35940202/4baec9359a0a7608c8609e7b121ebf6935bc0ffc.png[/img]

Overall we made Sunshade a lot easier with this Update. However the game will still be a small challenge if you intend to see all the content with one single playthrough. We've added two new Endings: One which allows you to join the Heart in her Corruption and the other one adds the option to leave the Island with Tulip and Galan. 

Unlike the previous two big updates, Dreams of Fate has no specific focus. its adding a bit of everything to the game while making changes to many existing systems and gameplay loops. Your feedback played a huge part in many of the changes.

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Two new endings
[*] Gameplay and Combat reworked/rebalanced
[*] Lots of new Items to find and craft
[*] New Characters (Including sexy harpies)
[*] Ending and Mainstory reworked
[*] New Secrets and Puzzles
[*] New HUD elements such as the Relationship Window
[*] New Enemies 
[*] New Outfits 
[*] Lots of kinky new scenes
[*] Steam Achievements
[/list]

[h2]Screenshots[/h2]

notes.title: Below Sunshade - Update Announcement
notes.content:
[h2]Hey folks![/h2]

We're happy to announce the next and final chapter for Below Sunshade.

The [b]Final Update[/b] will be released in [b]Q4 2021[/b] and of course free for everyone who owns the game as with our previous updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35940202/c32bd1256652b5bbae9b7199f00208045ccb544d.png[/img]

[h1]What's to expect?[/h1]

This update will mainly focus on two things: Fixing Bugs and adding content that has been highly requested by our players.

[b]Here's a quick rundown of what exactly you can expect[/b]
[list]
[*] Tons of bugfixes
[*] New ways to customize your playstyle
[*] New Adult Scenes
[*] New Outfits for our favorite characters
[*] More Playerbase customization
[*] A new NPC who functions as follower and who will join you in battle
[/list]
We hope you're as excited as we are for this update. Below Sunshade was our first game on steam. We've released two big content updates (Heart of the Island and Milestones) so far and we're confident that this final update will be a great addition for the game.

[h2]Until then?[/h2]

[b]There's still a few months left, so let us know in this thread what content and features you want to see! [/b]In the meantime we're also releasing our second title on Steam: Arenus. Which has been in developement for over four years now. We'll also try to contact steam to get discount codes for Arenus for everyone who bought Below Sunshade. 

[b]Thank you all for your support and trust.[/b]

Stay tuned!

- Kaliyo

notes.content:
Hey folks! 

Hope you're ready for the Milestones update! Our biggest update for Below Sunshade so far.

[*]Introducing two new characters! Tulip and Galan. The sexy goblin alchemist and the young adventerous elf. Each one with their own storyline. Tulip is voiced by the talented Oolay-Tigher while Galan is voiced over by LewdAudio. Also DornVA returned for new Idrune Scenes.

[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35940202/9f7a0dc6e20f3e174d3cfe156945e922a8c39fd9.png[/img]

[i]We hope you enjoy the new content!

Stay tuned

notes.title: Announcement - Below Sunshade: Milestones
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35940202/5646795258a383fb8e5267704a2f6f90037f57e5.gif[/img]

Hey folks!

We are happy to announce ...

[h3]Below Sunshade: Milestones[/h3]

Our next DLC for Below Sunshade and our largest one so far. Just like Heart of the Island, our new DLC will be free for all current and future owners of Below Sunshade.

I'll keep this post fairly short because Milestones will be released on the [b]10th November 2020[/b] already.

[h3]What to expect[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]New characters and storylines! [/b]
We're aware that the first few days on the island are rather slow and that a lot of players felt lost in what to do. Our goal with this new DLC, besides improving the whole game, is to focus on adding content to its early game.

[*][b]Milestone System![/b]
Found a secret? Cleared a dungeon or completed a Quest? You'll now be rewarded with Milestone Points when doings so. You can spend those on special perks with the following three categories: Combat, Exploration and Crafting. This allows you to play the game even more like you want.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35940202/5b9fb259c6aa219fdb012cc310e34b88dfcbb9a2.png[/img]

[*][b]The Island revisited![/b]
We've been making heavy changes to the whole gameflow to reduce grind and make the game overall a more smooth experience. This includes a lot of bugfixes and QoL changes! No more slow movement speed after loading the game, no more flickering busts during dialogues.

[*][b]And more![/b]
New Enemies, dungeons, locations to visit. New scenes with existing island inhabitants. New Items and weapons to craft and completly new gameplay features.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35940202/9ad5f24eab0bec0cbbcb02bf03b7b095f2ff7db6.png[/img]

[/list]
We hope you are looking forward to this update!

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Below Sunshade: Heart of the Island
notes.content:
Heart of the Island is our first free DLC for Below Sunshade. 
Our goal with this DLC was to connect story strings and turn Below Sunshade into a more compelling game to play through overall. We hope you enjoy the new content.

[h1]New Features[/h1]

[h3]The Heart[/h3]
A new Location featuring a new character. The heart features a whole new storyline with two possible paths to chose from. A path of light and a path of corruption.

The Heart is voiced by the fantastic [b][url=https://twitter.com/BordeauxBlackVA]Bordeaux Black[/url][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35940202/b65fb3c06e743009d4c3bd1a3c16f0f5558beb58.png[/img]

[h3]New Dialogue Features[/h3]
Idrune, Talitha and all other characters now breath and blink during conversations.
We've added this feature to provide more immersive dialogues.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35940202/cb81c51ae660cd40f9c327cb1eb64499721ac4b9.png[/img]

[h3]Living Orbs[/h3]
Those orbs are the remains of a forgotten civilization. 
Find them and they will support you in battle.

[h3]New Enemies[/h3]
A few new enemies have been added to the Island: From corrupted boars to a dangerous naga.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35940202/98c852bc1321fa2adcbfd3ee01c027b50ee5383b.png[/img]

[h3]CG Gallery[/h3]
You're now able to view unlocked CG Pictures in the new gallery.
We'll expand on the gallery in the future.

[h3]And more...[/h3]
We've fixed bugs, rebalanced aspects of the game and of course added a few new items.
You're also able to give Idrune a task per day. For example you can ask her now to gather some branches for you.

Thank you for your support and stay tuned.
We're aware that the first few days of Sunshade would do well with some new content. ;)

[*]Story Mode! No more Day/Time Limit for those of you who want to unlock all the content.
[*]New Talitha Scene! Encounter Talitha in a private situation.
[*]New Idrune Scene! An additional CG Scene path added to Idrune's second sexy encounter.
[*]New Naipei Scene! An additional CG Scene path for the Naipei & Fang ending

[/list]

We hope you enjoy the new content! 
Thanks for your support and let us know what you would like to see in Below Sunshade!

- Kal
